# Large language models generate diagnostic likelihood ratios with low mean bias but wide dispersion

Repository: https://github.com/reblocke/llm_estimate_lrs
Article: Large language models generate diagnostic likelihood ratios with low mean bias but wide dispersion
DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-026-61766-2
Article status: Published online in Scientific Reports on 11 July 2026 as an unedited early-access article
Paper snapshot: v1.0.0, published 11 July 2026
Current release: v1.1.0, published 27 July 2026

## Reproduce the accepted analysis

```bash
pip install uv
uv lock --check
make setup
make reproduce
make test
```

`make setup` may download locked dependencies. Reproduction and tests use frozen local artifacts only, make no OpenAI API calls or live TheNNT requests, and do not overwrite accepted inputs or reference results.

## Accepted manuscript models

- GPT-4o: `gpt-4o-2024-11-20`
- o3: `o3-2025-04-16`
- GPT-5: `gpt-5`

The GPT-5 alias identifies the accepted historical run and does not guarantee identical future hosted-model behavior.

## Canonical artifacts

- Dataset: `data/curated/diagnostic_lrs_manuscript_v1.csv`
- Model outputs: `data/model_outputs/manuscript_model_outputs_v1.csv`
- Threshold outputs: `data/model_outputs/threshold_perturbation_v1/`
- Model configuration: `config/manuscript_models_v1.json`
- Main prompt: `prompts/main_estimator_v1.json`
- Threshold prompt: `prompts/threshold_perturbation_v1.json`
- Paper manifest: `manifests/manuscript_run_v1.json`
- Reference results: `results/reference/`
- Main analysis: `data_analysis.ipynb`
- Supplementary analysis: `supplementary_analyses.ipynb`
- Pre-production author-manuscript text: `llms-full.txt`

## Release boundary

`v1.0.0` is the immutable accepted-paper snapshot. `v1.1.0` adds documentation, metadata, validation, and machine-readable guidance without changing an accepted input, output, prompt, configuration, notebook, statistic, figure, interpretation, or conclusion.

## Replication boundary

A live rerun is a new replication, not reproduction of the accepted paper. It requires an API key, explicit models, a call ceiling, confirmation, and a new output directory; see `docs/REPLICATION.md`.

## Safety and reuse

Do not add API keys, restricted data, private correspondence, publisher proofs, local execution artifacts, or unreviewed drafts. MIT covers original repository software only; literature-derived values, model outputs, and article text retain distinct provenance and reuse boundaries.

`llms-full.txt` is shared separately under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 and is not the publisher Version of Record. See `docs/DATA_PROVENANCE.md` and `metadata/rights_and_licenses.yml`.
